svg.aria-label: A day with wsl-spawner. Sign-in: it starts the distributions you chose. All day: it keeps them running. Sign-out: its hook runs last and gives each service its time. Next start: the containers come back and it says how the last run ended. Under it, a distribution's day as cells: starting, running, its stop, off, back.
